label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_clerk_00
text: Welcome! Feel free to look around and get\nacquainted with our Elite Four team!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_clerk_01
text: Welcome to the Polar Plaza! We’re the team that\nsupports Drayton of the Elite Four!

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_clerk_03
text: You’ll need to hand over 50 BP if you want\nto take on the Elite Trial here.\c\nAre you ready and willing to pay?

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_dragonbb_01
text: Whoa, hold up! My friend here gets in free![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_clerk_04
text: A-are you sure, Drayster? The rules say—

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_dragonbb_02
text: Just charge it to my account. That oughta take\ncare of it, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_clerk_05
text: That’s not—\n...OK, understood. I’ll make an exception.

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_dragonbb_04
text: There’s my Champ in the making! Thanks\nfor coming.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_4kings_d_01_dragonbb_05
text: Let’s hit the battle court real quick.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
